samples.name: 周小满
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production character standing portrait for the Chinese modern banking career simulation game 银行升职记. Primary request: exactly ONE character, 周小满 (Zhou Xiaoman), a young adult Chinese woman aged 24, a conscientious second-year bank teller from Nanchuan, Chongqing. Clean fresh Japanese anime / modern visual novel character art, crisp elegant thin lines, polished cel shading with restrained soft shading, expressive believable face, distinct adult facial proportions, no photorealism, no painterly thick strokes. Dark brown shoulder-length hair tied into a low ponytail with soft wispy bangs, warm brown eyes, gentle attentive slightly shy smile. Contemporary professional Chinese bank uniform: ivory buttoned blouse, tailored muted deep ink-green waistcoat, a small muted gold and green silk neck scarf, dark straight skirt. She holds a tidy small stack of generic blank bank slips with both hands at waist level, fingers anatomically clear. Composition: single centered three-quarter standing figure from full top of head down to mid-thigh, entire head, both shoulders, both elbows and both hands visible without cropping; 3:4 portrait layout with modest breathing room on all sides; eye level, front facing with a slight natural three-quarter turn. Isolated on genuinely transparent alpha background, no scene, no ground plane, no decorative graphics. Palette: harmonious ivory, ink green, muted gold; natural warm skin tones. Light soft and bright, premium wholesome workplace anime cast portrait, attractive but grounded. No text, no Chinese characters, no watermark, no border, no logo, no identification card text, no extra people, no sexualized pose, no chibi, no huge eyes, no props other than the blank slips. This is the first style calibration sample, must read clearly when reduced into an in-game character card.
